Shizuku runs a helper with ADB-level access so Able can disable or restore apps and change protected settings. Anything Able does with it is shown and confirmed first, and checked afterwards. Revoke it any time in the Shizuku app; stopping Shizuku turns these actions off.

This grant lets Able change protected system settings such as Private DNS. It can only be given from a computer with ADB. Wrong values can break connectivity, so Able shows what it changes and reads it back. Revoke with “pm revoke” or by uninstalling Able.

When this is on and Able crashes, a dialog asks whether to send a report. If you choose Send, your email app opens with the report attached, addressed to info.dragolabs@gmail.com; you can read, edit or cancel it. The report contains the error stack trace, Able version, Android version, device brand and model, and build details. Nothing is sent automatically, no third-party servers are used and there are no feature analytics. Off: no dialog and nothing is collected.
Export saves only the sections you pick to a .ablebackup file you choose. Import shows a preview first and saves a restore point, so you can undo it.

Replace overwrites every included section with the file content; your current values for those sections are lost. A restore point is saved first, so you can undo it from Settings → Backup & transfer. Choose Merge to keep what you have.
